title: Read an array item
summary: PowerShell: Read an array item. Read the first item.
introduction: An array holds several values. Its first index is zero. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Read an array item with PowerShell

blocks.text: Open PowerShell 7. Paste one example or save it as lesson.ps1 and run pwsh -NoProfile -File lesson.ps1. No administrator access is needed.
The array is zero-based. Its second position is index 1.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use @() when you need an array shape even with one item.
